notes: Fixed assets tax book reference data for Congolese companies (docs/modules/fixed-assets.md FA-20). Structure only: class keys. No method or rate is entered until it is confirmed from an official source with its legal reference and effective date; a class with a null method or rate, or needs_confirmation true, is unconfirmed and the tax book is refused. Labels live in lang/{locale}/fixed_assets.php (tax_classes.*).
todo: Public research (2026-10-17, docs/country-packs-research-2026-10.md) found no statutory class table; usual practice is straight line at commonly accepted rates (low confidence). Nothing is entered and the tax book stays refused.
Code des impôts: confirm the classes of fiscally deductible depreciation (amortissements) and which assets fall in each.
buildings (constructions): method (linéaire or dégressif with its coefficient), annual rate and effective date, with the legal reference.
machinery (matériel et outillage): method, annual rate and effective date.
motor_vehicles (matériel de transport): method, annual rate and effective date.
computers (matériel informatique): method, annual rate and effective date.
furniture (mobilier et matériel de bureau): method, annual rate and effective date.
other: any other class, its method and rate.
acquisition_rule: whether the year of acquisition counts as a full year (full_year) or pro rata by months in service (pro_rata_months), with the legal reference.
Disposals: the tax treatment in the year of disposal (until confirmed the tax book gives no allowance that year and computes no adjustment).
